name: The Hunter's Way
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You are eager to explore, I can tell.  I too had the lust to wander, once...

Wander, and hunt.  For hunting is a Tauren's greatest honor.

If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then Melor Stonehoof can show you the path.  He is in Thunder Bluff, on the Hunter's Rise.

And to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore.  They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young champion on the hunter's path.
narrative.objectives: Bring 4 Flatland Prowler Claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Skorn Whitecloud is a wise tauren. He has hunted for years and years, and although his body is old, his spirit burns fiercely. We are honored to have him with us.

If Skorn sent you to me, then you too must have the hunter's spirit. And to have gathered these claws shows your burgeoning skills.

Perhaps you are ready to walk the path.
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetings. There is an air about you that tells me much. Do we have business, you and I?
